KGlobalAccel is required on Linux desktop platforms and KWidgetsAddons is required on non-Android builds by KDE upstream v6.30.0; both are selected in the SupraLINUX Linux profile.

KCoreAddons and KCodecs are marked REQUIRED by upstream feature summary. KArchive and KConfig are optional upstream integrations and are selected because compatible retained SupraLINUX providers are available.
